description.value: Bai Bua Thai Cuisine is an authentic Thai restaurant operated by a professional Thai chef on East Hastings Street in Vancouver's east side. The restaurant offers Thai street food in a dine-in setting, alongside takeout and catering options. It accommodates gluten-free and vegetarian diners and accepts reservations by phone.

address.value: 1-2443 East Hastings Street, Vancouver, BC V5K 1Y8

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands at 20m; rack (7 spaces) at 92m. Total: 7 spaces.
